status: pre-confirmatory theoretical and software freeze; not statistical preregistration
seed_reservation: 0-9 already observed; 10-49 reserved, not executed by C2.0; primitive accepts innovations, not seeds

policy_modes.Q00: NONE; frozen prospective b and S
policy_modes.Q10: INFORMATION_ONLY; evolving prospective b, frozen prospective S
policy_modes.Q01: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; frozen prospective b, evolving prospective S
policy_modes.Q11: INFORMATION_AND_DEVELOPMENT; evolving prospective b and S

common_numerics.tie_breaking: first enumerated action within tolerance of maximum
common_numerics.quadrature: existing three-node Gauss-Hermite per positive-mass hypothesis

equations.X00_star: first frozen-tolerance-optimal action maximizing immediate g
equations.H: -sum_(m:b_m>0) b_m log(b_m); natural log, unnormalized nats
equations.D_I_norm: D_I / sum_(m<n) b_m b_n if denominator>0; null otherwise
equations.B: unchanged finite Gaussian Bayes using pre-development S and candidate X
equations.V_I: sum_m b_m sum_j omega_j max_U g(B(b,S,X,r_mj),S,U)
equations.V_ID: sum_m b_m sum_j omega_j max_U g(B(b,S,X,r_mj),F(S,X),U)
equations.terminal: remaining=1: all Q=g; no primary two-decision counterfactual
equations.G_t_2: mu_true(t)+mu_true(t+1), exactly two within-problem real rewards

opportunity_implementation: hls.campaign2_theory.opportunity_landscape; V=Q-g from frozen prospective_action_values; no duplicate quadrature

counterfactual.branch_A: force pi_ab first action; then use pi_ab
counterfactual.branch_B: force actual frozen pi_00 first action; then use the SAME pi_ab
counterfactual.true_z: fixed and identical in both branches; not supplied to unknown planner
counterfactual.real_transitions: Bayes and enabled MIS-v2 after BOTH actions, independent of prospective mode
counterfactual.crn: two caller-supplied standard-normal innovations, shared by position; r_branch=mu_branch+sigma*epsilon
counterfactual.endpoint_qualification: second decision replans with real remaining-1; if initially remaining=3 it can anticipate stage 3, whose reward is excluded from G_t_2
counterfactual.baseline_numerical_qualification: landscape immediate-myopic and actual Q00 share mathematical policy; inherited constant-addition tolerance-boundary caveat retained

hypotheses_not_tested.H1: Hypothesis-Conditioned Myopic Regret and belief/action disagreement help characterize information-relevant structural states; no iff
hypotheses_not_tested.H2: global headroom alone is insufficient; study pre-decision capability/problem/history structure and differential A_D landscapes; no algebra-as-discovery
hypotheses_not_tested.H3: test whether confirmatory states include X11 not in {X10,X01}; characterize Gamma and full landscape without Gamma>C or sign assumptions
hypotheses_not_tested.H4: internal prospective preference does not guarantee positive realized Delta G_t_2; quantify positive/zero/negative returns; M is non-directional

potential_confirmatory_quantities: exact action divergence with existing tie diagnostics
tautology_boundary: A_I/A_D/A_ID reconstruct operator rankings by definition; not independent empirical causes or scientific discoveries
prohibited_interpretations: Gamma as physical/team synergy or causal interaction
global policy value from a one-action intervention

validation.Q11_reference: unchanged frozen planner; existing six-case exact historical CURRENT candidate regression rerun in test_policy_ablation.py
